explication: Tasks is a cross-platform task-management application descended from Astrid, with Android and desktop entry points and companion Pebble/wearable support. The principal workflow is a user entering the app, working with task-list and task-edit screens, and having task data persist; alarm handling and account synchronization are important supporting stages. The excerpts show database entities, query execution, alarm behavior, authentication, and wearable services. Several major subsystems are represented from the README and source index; their internal call paths were not sampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
